verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth docs list password and social login among supported methods [supabase-docs-6], and a community developer reports building a backend with Supabase OAuth providers [supabase-comm-17]. The docs promise quickstarts that connect a project in minutes [supabase-docs-19], and llms.txt references per-language client reference corpora (JS, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Python, C#) [supabase-supp-llms-agent-resources]. missing for 10: no evidence of the specific SDK sign-up/sign-in or OAuth calls, no auth-specific quickstart showing a minutes-level setup, and no hands-on corroboration of email/password setup speed.
